explain.kvah: kVAh is the total electricity your factory drew, including the part that does no useful work. HT bills are charged in kVAh.
explain.pf: Power factor is kWh divided by kVAh. Close to 1 is good. Below 0.90 can add a penalty to your bill.
explain.mdKva: Maximum demand is the highest load your factory reached in the month. Demand charges are based on it.

health.title: Bill health check: {{month}}
health.noFindings: No problems found on this bill.

fix.power_factor: Fit or repair a capacitor bank (APFC panel) to bring power factor to 0.98 or above.
fix.peak_use: Move shiftable work out of 6-10 am and 6-10 pm into 10 am-6 pm.
fix.contracted_demand: Ask TGSPDCL to reduce contracted demand closer to your real maximum demand.
fix.minimum_charges: Your use is below the minimum billed units; check the contracted demand.
fix.lt_surcharges: Your bill carries a power factor or capacitor surcharge; fit a capacitor.
